note: The showroom atelier of the Maison de Couture: choice, luxury, customs and cunning. The gilded mirror-pillar in the middle divides it: feminine nouns on its left, masculine (and élégant) on its right. The blank wall left of the pillar opens a zoom onto the cushion corner (R_abs_beauty_01_z1). The doorway on the left goes back to the salon; the doorway on the right leads on to the picture gallery.
